tools.name: search_resort_knowledge
tools.title: Search resort knowledge
tools.description: Search Silverthorn Resort's public knowledge base (houseboats, cabins, small boats, marina pages, FAQs, Shasta Lake and Forest Service info) and return the best matching entries with their page URLs.

query.description: What to look up, e.g. 'Queen houseboat hot tub' or 'boat ramps'.

tools.name: get_resort_policies
tools.title: Get resort policies
tools.description: Return Silverthorn Resort's exact published policy facts (deposits, cancellation, check-in/out, fuel, pets, parking) for houseboats and cabins, with the page each fact lives on.

topic.description: Optional filter, e.g. 'cancellation', 'pets', 'deposit'. Omit to return every policy fact.

tools.name: list_fleet
tools.title: List rental fleet
tools.description: List Silverthorn Resort's rental fleet: houseboats (Queen, Queen I, Queen II, Senator) and small boats (patio, ski, fishing boats, jet skis) with capacity, pricing and page URLs.

kind.description: Which part of the fleet to list.
